title: DANA Inc 8-K Filing — 2026-04-29
summary: Dana Incorporated filed an 8-K with the SEC on April 29, 2026, announcing Q1 2026 results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing references Items 2.02 and 7.01 (Results of Operations and Regulation FD Disclosure) and includes a press release as Exhibit 99.1. This is a routine corporate disclosure from an automotive parts supplier listed on the NYSE (ticker: DAN).
